note: Adapted from the entry of Chhotani (1997) (Trinervitermes rubidus (Hagen), Figs. 374-376), originally in English; the synonymy list, the figure numbers and the distribution records are not translated. The specific name is spelt rubidus in that work (Termes rubidus Hagen, 1860, type locality Colombo, Sri Lanka), which is a spelling variant of the rabidus used on this site (Hagen, 1859, type locality Sri Lanka: Colombo), with the same author and the same type locality, and the literature years differ by one. The alate total length without wings is given in the original as “7.5-B.o mm”, “B.o” being an OCR error, and is translated as 8.0 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown; dorsum of the abdomen brown, dark straw-coloured in the middle, brownish below on the sides; pronotum pale brown. Head and body with numerous hairs. Total length (with wings) 17.0 mm, (without wings) 7.5–8.0 mm. Head capsule nearly square to subcircular, rounded posteriorly (length to the mandibular base 1.13 mm, width including the eyes 1.48–1.59 mm); the dorsum slightly concave at the middle; coronal suture not very distinct. Fontanelle plate semi-transparent, V-shaped (recorded as triangular by Holmgren 1913b). Compound eyes medium-sized, subcircular (maximum diameter 0.45 mm). Ocelli nearly oval (long diameter 0.23 mm, short diameter 0.20 mm), close to the compound eye (eye–ocellus distance 0.05 mm). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 only slightly longer than segment 2; segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus moderately raised, setose; slightly less than half as long as wide. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal (length 0.85 mm, width 1.30 mm); the anterior margin nearly straight, not incised at the middle; the posterior margin slightly convex, without a notch. Wings yellow to brown; densely covered with fine hairs and punctate (i.e. with spinules); forewing length 12.80 mm, hindwing length 12.40 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major soldier: head capsule and nasus reddish brown; the fontanelle gland area paler; abdominal tergites dark straw-coloured. Head and abdominal tergites without long hairs, the sternites with long and short hairs; the tip of the nasus with several short hairs, the pronotum with fine hairs. Total length 4.20–5.30 mm. Head capsule (without the nasus) nearly pyriform to subcircular; the length without the nasus about equal to the width (length including the nasus 2.15–2.35 mm, length without the nasus 1.37–1.40 mm, maximum width 1.15–1.32 mm); in lateral view strongly incurved behind the nasus; the occiput arched; nasus projection absent; the posterior part strongly inflated (head inflation index, i.e. posterior inflation / head length without the nasus, 0.73–0.75). Nasus short, conical (length 0.78–0.95 mm, nasus length / head length index 0.56–0.68). Antennae 12–13-segmented; segment 3 twice as long as segment 2; segment 4 as long as segment 2. Mandibles reduced, without spines. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.20 mm, width 0.58–0.63 mm); the anterior lobe extremely upturned, the anterior margin strongly and broadly concave; the posterior margin slightly convex. Minor soldier: head capsule brown; nasus blackish brown, brownish at the tip; abdominal tergites brown. Head with a few small hairs; the tip of the nasus with several long and short hairs; abdominal tergites without long hairs, the sternites with long and short hairs. Total length 3.50–3.80 mm. Head capsule (without the nasus) nearly rectangular, the sides nearly straight (length including the nasus 1.43–1.60 mm, length without the nasus 0.83–0.93 mm, maximum width 0.59–0.60 mm); in lateral view weakly incurved; nasus projection absent; the posterior part of the head distinctly inflated (head inflation index 0.65–0.70). Nasus long and slender, cylindrical; its length about 3/4 of the major head length without the nasus (length 0.60–0.68 mm, nasus length / head length index 0.73–0.75). Antennae distinctly long, 12-segmented; segment 3 about twice as long as segment 2; segment 4 shorter than segment 3 but longer than segment 2. Mandibles reduced, without spines. Pronotum small, saddle-shaped (length 0.15–0.18 mm, width 0.38–0.48 mm); the anterior margin rounded, without a notch; the posterior margin convex.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule brown; antennae, postclypeus, pronotum and legs straw-coloured; abdominal tergites pale brown. Head and body with a few small hairs; abdominal sternites with long and short hairs. Total length 4.00–5.75 mm. Head capsule nearly square (length to the mandibular base 0.80–1.20 mm, width 0.93–1.38 mm); coronal suture distinct. Fontanelle plate nearly triangular, semi-transparent. Antennae 15-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 nearly equal in length. Postclypeus raised, with a few hairs; about half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.13–0.23 mm, width 0.45–0.53 mm); the anterior and posterior margins convex, without a notch.
